disguise.rowHelp: Makes LangQuest look like a calculator or a notepad on this phone. It opens only with a code you choose.
disguise.title: App icon
disguise.ownHelp: Puts LangQuest's own icon back. It opens with no code.
disguise.lookHelp: Chooses this icon. Next you choose the code that opens LangQuest.
disguise.codeHelp: 4 to 12 digits. On the calculator, type it on the keys. On the notepad, type it on a line of its own.
disguise.nextHelp: Opens the calculator or notepad, so you type your code on it.

nearby.startLine: Sharing starts only when you press Start sharing, and stops after ten minutes or once you are up to date.
nearby.startHelp: Turns on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi to find teammates nearby, for up to ten minutes.
nearby.warning: Someone with the right equipment can tell that this phone is broadcasting, and Android's questions will show the app's real name. Do this where you are alone.
nearby.warnedHelp: Goes on to share. Android may ask for permission next.
nearby.left: Sharing stopped because you left the app.
nearby.letInLook: The new phone will show LangQuest until they choose another look under More settings.
